verdict.rationale: Retell documents a built-in knowledge base: you can crawl a website or upload documents that the agent retrieves from. Knowledge bases are also manageable through the CLI, inspectable by Conductor (sources, indexing status) and scored for accuracy by AI QA. The evidence is mostly summary-level overview snippets, not a dedicated knowledge-base guide. missing for 10: in-depth knowledge-base docs (supported file types, chunking and retrieval settings, refresh and sync behavior), independent or hands-on corroboration of retrieval quality.
